query: EAU project website environment agent user co-evolution
text:
1. **Official EAU project website** — Introduces the Environment–Agent–User co-evolution framework, results, and forthcoming code.  
   People: Min Cai (University of Alberta), Dan Zhang (National University of Singapore), Gao Xing and Libin Ma (Kuaishou Technology), Zhaohui Xu (independent researcher), and Xi Ye (University of Alberta; Alberta Machine Intelligence Institute/Amii).  
   URL: [https://eau-meta-agent.github.io/](https://eau-meta-agent.github.io/)

2. **Official arXiv paper** — “EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents,” submitted October 12, 2026. It describes a meta-agent that jointly adapts the user simulator, environment, rewards, and RL configuration.  
   People and affiliations: the same six researchers and institutions listed above.  
   URL: [https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523)

3. **Min Cai’s research page** — Lead author’s page, listing EAU among his agent-training research.  
   Person: Min Cai, PhD student at the University of Alberta, advised by Xi Ye; previously affiliated with Baidu, Z.ai, and Shenzhen University.  
   URL: [https://henrycai11.github.io/](https://henrycai11.github.io/)
